name: Nimbus
description: All-in-one optimization for client and server: its own terrain renderer (GPU culling, occlusion culling, instanced entities and particles, distant LOD), a shader pack loader that works without Iris, Lithium-style server optimizations, lower memory use and faster loading. Replaces Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast and more; changes nothing visible by default.
